task_month_allocation.note: The draft gives month ranges per work package (¶253, ¶264, ¶276, ¶289, ¶303) but no task-level months. Derivation: each task inherits its work package's full month range, which adds no information the draft does not state. Phase 4 narrows tasks to months; this seed deliberately does not pre-empt that by guessing sub-ranges. Exception: none — every task uses the inherited range. task_month_allocation.placement_window_indication: Input pack item 8 names T5.6, the AgroVIR functional and interoperability assessment, as the natural occupant of the M25-M30 placement window. It is recorded here rather than written into the allocation below, because narrowing one task to a sub-range while its six siblings keep the inherited range would pre-empt Phase 4 on the strength of a single word ('natural') in the pack. Phase 4 owns the narrowing and should start from this indication.

entries.note: Corrected from 0.24 to 2.4 — a misplaced decimal. About ten working days a year across 30 months, for supervision, data preparation and experiment access.

WP4 target domain, M12-M21: trial hosting, ground and physiological measurement, data preparation under the pre-registered protocol, the contact and steering-group role, and co-authorship of the transfer-test outputs.

Built bottom-up from item 4's accepted governance over 30 months: weekly one-to-ones with preparation, monthly progress-record reviews, quarterly Career Development Plan reviews, chairing the Steering Group, reading the P1-P4 drafts and deliverables, and delivering the eleven §1.3 competences. About 8% FTE.

Weekly technical sessions through the modelling-intensive window WP3-WP4 (M6-M21), tapering to monthly outside it, plus the quarterly Career Development Plan reviews, Steering Group membership, and review of the modelling and validation-design outputs D3.1, D3.2, D4.2 and D4.3 with the model card.

co_supervisor_figure_contradiction.what: Input pack item 8 carries two figures for the co-supervisor. Its answer block reads 2.0 and states a partner in-kind total of 11.4, which 2.4 + 1.5 + 3.0 + 2.5 + 2.0 satisfies exactly. Its derivation paragraph reads 1.5, which would make the total 10.9 and contradict the stated total.
co_supervisor_figure_contradiction.why: The 1.5 derivation is built on 'fortnightly technical sessions ... through M6-M21', and item 4 supersedes that cadence: it raises the co-supervisor's sessions to weekly through WP3 and WP4 once the operator confirmed he is responsible for model development and testing. Weekly sessions across that window roughly double the session hours in the derivation, which lands the figure at about 2.0. So the answer block is the post-amendment value and the derivation paragraph is stale, not the other way round. The stated total corroborates it.
co_supervisor_figure_contradiction.status: Resolved at the fold rather than referred back, because both readings are the operator's own and one of them is arithmetically inconsistent with the total the operator also stated. The figure is Assumed either way, it is in kind and uncosted, and it changes no gate.
co_supervisor_figure_contradiction.operator_confirmation: The ticket 7 authorisation packet put the correction to the operator, who confirmed 2.0 on 2026-08-12 and restated the reasoning: the figure was raised when Dr. Hollós was confirmed responsible for model development and testing, with the cadence raised from fortnightly to weekly through WP3 and WP4 (M6-M21). The partner in-kind total stands at 11.4. The contradiction is closed. The figure remains Assumed, because it is an in-kind estimate the partner has not seen, not because the reading is in doubt. Recorded in decision_log/fieldwise-ticket7-open-items_2026-08-12.json.

open_consequences_for_phase_4: The monthly profile is tighter than it was. M16-M21 now carries WP4 and a heavier WP5 concurrently. The totals fit inside 30 person-months over 30 months, but phase_04_gate's check that concurrent work packages never demand more than one FTE in any month is the one that will tell. Partner in-kind effort is outside that check.

The draft's four corrective decision points at M6, M12, M16 and M20 left a ten-month unmonitored tail in a 30-month action. The operator closed half of it on 2026-08-12 by adding a fifth Steering Group decision point at M27, on the ground that the placement is evaluated and must not run unmonitored. The placement-completion milestone that input pack item 8 also raised was not adopted. Both outcomes are recorded in milestones_seed.json.
